vehiculum

vehiculum, vehiculī n.

noun, second declension

a vehicle, a carriage, a cart

In this lexicon

    the recommended word · classical · Plaut. Aul. 3.5.28: mihi aequum est darī vehicula, quī vehar (Lewis & Short); Liv. 34.1.3: jūnctum vehiculum (Lewis & Short); Traupman 174, 217, 397; Traupman 219: transportation, vehicula

  • vehiculum puerīle: pram

    modern

  • vehiculum onerārium; vehiculī onerāriī n.: truck

    modern

  • vehiculum ūnirotum; vehiculī ūnirotī n.: wheelbarrow

    modern
